description: In a document that keeps the `development` pack: a unit’s closing pass in one call, for a list of units by `ref`: their new `decisions` (date, milestone, scope and `state: live` default to the unit’s), the unit to `built` with `landed` (default today), `files` and `decision` (default its first new one), its `review_entries` (`state: open` default), `close_milestone`, its git `commit` (refused without one unless `same_commit: true`) and `branch` (another than the claim’s refused unless `other_branch`), and the `report` of the session that built it. Or `inbox`: ids of a child’s proposals — an inbox row, `state: new`, `refs` its unit, its `body` one ```json block of one unit’s landing (no `close_milestone`), written to the document path the hooks printed — each landed as written and moved to `applied`. Each step is `record_format_rows` or `update_format_rows`, judged as they are, run in that order; all of it applies or none. Diff by format; writes nothing until `commit: true`.

commit.description: Write it. Omit or false for the dry run.

inbox.description: Inbox row ids of landing proposals, or `{id, other_branch}`.

path.description: Absolute path to a .emd file on this machine.

branch.description: The git branch it lands from.

commit.description: The git commit carrying its work.

other_branch.description: Land it although claimed on another branch.

report.description: Its builder’s closing report, plain text, up to 4000 characters.

same_commit.description: The work is in the same commit as this landing.

name: land_units
title: Land units
